messages:
maya chen: ACME flagged a sudden spike in embed counts after they upgraded to vendor-sdk v2.1. They say their app traffic didn't change.
juan ramos: can you paste a tiny log sample? looks like a retry loop perhaps.
maya chen: from ACME logs:
POST /v1/embeddings 200 92ms tokens=0 embeds=1 id=abc123
POST /v1/embeddings 200 95ms tokens=0 embeds=1 id=abc123

maya chen: identical ids within ~150ms — feels like client retries without stable request id.
kevin li: that would cause duplicate ingest if our pipeline counts each request. do they include a request-id header?
maya chen: vendor-sdk v2.1 emits an X-req-id but header casing/field name varies (x-request-id / X-Req-Id) across footprints. vendor claims they normalized, but some clients still vary.
sarah patel: immediate mitigation idea: dedupe by request-id or payload-hash for a short sliding window at the edge.
kevin li: doable. propose a 1s in-memory dedupe keyed by coalesced request_id || sha256(payload) + customer_id + model. low-risk canary first.
juan ramos: scale/impact numbers? ACME claims ~22k extra embeds in the last hour.
maya chen: preliminary ledger shows +21,980 embeds for acme-inc between 2026-02-28T09:00 and 10:00 UTC.
sarah patel: estimated $ delta?
kevin li: at $0.0004/embed => ~$8.8 for that window. small but multiple customers could amplify.
maya chen: ACME is requesting invoice adjustment and a targeted backfill to remove duplicates.
juan ramos: if we can prove duplicates via duplicate request-id or identical payload+id, we can run a backfill. approvals needed: (1) run backfill job, (2) provisional credit while audit/backfill runs.
sarah patel: finance: +1 to provisional credit up to $25 pending audit.
kevin li: I'll file MET-4321 for the dedupe rollout and backfill plan. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/785. Plan: 1) edge dedupe canary in ~4h, 2) ledger backfill removing events with duplicate (request_id || payload_hash) inside 2s window per customer, 3) audit report.
maya chen: ACME agreed to let us run the backfill and will share client logs.
juan ramos: accounting, please run a dedupe query to compute exact duplicate count and delta. proposed SQL:
SELECT customer_id, count(*) AS total, count(DISTINCT coalesce(request_id, sha256(payload))) AS unique_events, count(*) - count(DISTINCT coalesce(request_id, sha256(payload))) AS duplicates FROM embed_events WHERE customer_id = 'acme-inc' AND timestamp >= '2026-02-28 09:00:00' AND timestamp < '2026-02-28 11:00:00' GROUP BY customer_id;
billing-bot: Audit queued: job_id=aud-9982 ETA ~14m.
sarah patel: provisional credit FIN-2129 approved up to $25. require audit output before final crediting.
kevin li: timeline: canary in 4h, full backfill 24h after audit confirms duplicates. will also add vendor escalation VND-117 for SDK behavior fix request.
maya chen: tagging @juan ramos for memo signoff to ACME.
juan ramos: signed. cc billing@acme. include mitigation timeline and refund mechanics.
sarah patel: note: if backfill reveals broader vendor impact across accounts, finance will review caps and seek vendor reimbursement.
kevin li: will open vendor ticket and request consistent request-id header behavior.
maya chen: thanks all. I'll close after MET-4321 and FIN-2129 are linked in here.
